subject: SIG follow-up: tenant event streams, retention windows & exportable artifacts
messages:
From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@olivehealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@olivehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: tenant event streams + retention

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG intake we're trying to validate how Redwood surfaces tenant-level event logs for compliance (user events, model invocation metadata, and admin actions). A few concrete asks:

- Do you provide tenant-scoped, time-ordered event streams (not aggregated metrics)?
- What retention windows are configurable per-account (we need 365/730 day policy examples)?
- Can customers trigger ad-hoc exports of raw event slices (CSV or NDJSON) for a given time window and tenant ID?
- Are exports delivered to S3/GCS or only via API pull?

If you can point us to a quick sample extract and the SIG answers for these fields that would help us complete our submission. Happy to take a 20-min call this week.

Best,
Jake
Director, Platform Security
OliveHealth

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@olivehealth.com>, mina_haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: tenant event streams + retention

Hi Jake — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Mina (security) and Laura (legal) so you get definitive answers and an example export. Short answers up front:

- Tenant-scoped event streams: yes — we maintain a time-ordered event ledger per tenant that includes request metadata, caller identity, model id/version, latencies, and policy-evaluation outcomes.
- Retention windows: defaults are 90 days; we support configurable retention up to 730 days under Dedicated/Private plans and via an add-on for Hosted.
- Exports: customers can request ad-hoc exports via API or the Console; we also support push exports to a customer S3/GCS bucket.

I attached a small sample extract (redacted) and a draft playbook for exporting logs. Mina and Laura — can you validate the SIG responses and confirm any contractual constraints on retention for Hosted customers?

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: mina_haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Jake Turner <jake.turner@olivehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: tenant event streams + retention

Hi Jake, Vivek — adding detail and SIG-style verbatim that you can paste into the questionnaire. I've also attached the redacted CSV sample.

Quoted SIG responses (concise):
1) Audit/event logging scope: We produce tenant-scoped, append-only event logs for API calls and control-plane actions. Recorded fields include timestamp (ISO8601), tenant_id, request_id, principal (user/api-key), model_id, model_version, request_size_tokens, response_size_tokens, latency_ms, policy_decision, error_code (if any), and geo/region where inference executed.

2) Retention configuration: For Hosted customers, default retention is 90 days; retention can be extended to 365 or 730 days via a paid retention add-on. For Dedicated and Private deployments, retention is configurable in deployment config and can be aligned to customer policy up to 730 days. Retention deletions are irreversible and logged.

3) Export mechanisms: Exports supported via: (a) Console ad-hoc export (CSV/NDJSON) with tenant/time filters; (b) REST API endpoint to request an export job (async) that returns a signed S3/GCS URL when ready; (c) Automated push to customer-provided S3/GCS via service account for scheduled deliveries. Exports contain raw, redaction-ready event rows.

4) Access controls & proofs: Exports require either owner-level API key or an authorized Service Principal with explicit export scope. All export jobs are recorded in the tenant audit log with initiating principal and job_id.

5) Sample artifacts: attached = 'audit_log_sample_olive_20270409.csv' (redacted), and a draft playbook 'log_export_playbook_draft.docx' describing steps for scheduled exports and verification.

Notes: For SIG, we recommend including the sample CSV and the playbook. If Olive needs an NDA-scoped full sample (unredacted) we can provision a time-limited S3 share under a DPIA.

Mina Haddad
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@olivehealth.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: tenant event streams + retention

Jake — quick legal note to include in the SIG responses: for Hosted customers, retention extensions beyond the default require an amendment that specifies retention period and export responsibilities. For Private/Dedicated customers, retention is contractually configurable and subject to the customer's data lifecycle policies. We also log retention-policy changes as part of system configuration history.

I've updated the SIG_responses_v2.pdf to reflect the contractual language; attaching that here. Also flagged the option for Olive to receive exports directly into their S3 bucket; we'll need an S3 ARN and an IAM role/service account for push delivery.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- One redacted CSV sample included in the submission (we have it).
- Retention language to show we can get 365/730 under contract for Dedicated or via add-on for Hosted.
- We'll provide an S3 ARN (arn:aws:s3:::olivehealth-sig-exports) and a role during procurement.

Next steps: Vivek / Sean — can we schedule a 30-min handoff with our procurement + security next Thu?

Cheers,
Alice Moreno
